Key Takeaways:

Four suspects remanded to judicial custody in three trafficking cases

Victims subjected to confinement, abuse, exploitation; one rescued with help of tourist

Kathmandu District Court ordered custody; investigations ongoing

Four people have been remanded to judicial custody in connection with three separate cases involving human trafficking, forced labour and sexual exploitation, the Anti-Human Trafficking Bureau (AHTB) of Nepal Police said Wednesday.

According to the bureau, the cases involve two Bangladeshi nationals accused of trafficking and sexually assaulting a woman after luring her to Nepal with a false job offer, a Nepali man accused of coercing a woman into commercial sex work at a spa in Kathmandu, and a Nepali woman accused of trafficking another woman to the Maldives under the pretext of arranging employment in Qatar.

In the first case, Bangladeshi nationals Md Ujjal Miya, 38, and Manik Khan, 43, allegedly lured a woman to Kathmandu in February with a false job offer. Police said she was confined for four days in a Thamel hotel, sexually assaulted, and threatened with video recordings of the abuse. She was later forced to work without pay at a garment factory in Tarkeshwar Municipality. Both men were arrested separately and remanded by the Kathmandu District Court.

In the second case, police arrested Dipak alias Dirgha Bahadur Shrestha, 52, of Sindhupalchok, accused of coercing a woman into commercial sex work at a spa in Paknajol, Kathmandu, between mid-December 2025 and mid-January 2026. He has also been remanded to custody.

The third case involves Subina Gurung alias Rammaya Gurung, 43, of Okhaldhunga, accused of trafficking a woman under the pretext of arranging a hotel job in Qatar. Instead, the victim was taken via Delhi to the Maldives, where she was sold to a hotel owner for Rs 400,000, confined, abused and forced into sexual services. She eventually returned to Nepal with the help of an Indian tourist. Gurung has been remanded to custody following investigation.

The AHTB said further investigation into all three cases is underway.

title: Global rights groups raise concerns over Nepal’s judiciary - The Kathmandu Post
description: Global rights groups raise concerns over Nepal’s judiciary  The Kathmandu Post
publisher.title: The Kathmandu Post
full_article:
International rights organisations have expressed concern over what they describe as growing political interference in Nepal’s judiciary, warning that recent government actions could undermine the independence of the courts and weaken the rule of law.



In a joint statement, Amnesty International, Human Rights Watch, and the International Commission of Jurists (ICJ) stated that changes made to the Constitutional Council Act through an executive ordinance, along with reported pressure on senior Supreme Court justices, posed a serious threat to judicial independence.

The groups said the government’s decision in May to amend the Constitutional Council Act through an ordinance, rather than through parliamentary legislation, violated constitutional principles and raised concerns about the process for appointing officials to key constitutional bodies, including the chief justice.

The amendment changed the quorum and voting requirements of the Constitutional Council, the body responsible for recommending appointments to major constitutional positions. The rights organisations said the changes increased the possibility of political influence over judicial appointments because government representatives already hold a majority of seats on the council.

“The independence of the judiciary is a cornerstone of the rule of law and an essential safeguard for the protection of human rights,” Ian Seiderman, senior legal and policy director at the ICJ said in the statement. “Any reform of Nepal’s justice system should strengthen, not weaken, the independence, impartiality and integrity of the courts.”

The groups also questioned the appointment of Manoj Kumar Sharma as chief justice, saying it departed from Nepal’s long-standing practice of appointing the senior-most serving justice.

Although three senior judges remain on the Supreme Court, Sharma was appointed chief justice after being endorsed by the Parliamentary Hearing Committee. The organisations said complaints raised against his nomination were not subjected to meaningful public scrutiny.

The groups claimed that they had received credible reports that three senior Supreme Court justices, Sapana Pradhan Malla, Kumar Regmi and Hari Phuyal, had been pressured to resign under the threat of impeachment.

They said they were not aware of any publicly stated allegations against the judges that would meet the constitutional requirements for impeachment.

Under Nepal’s constitution, the initiation of impeachment proceedings automatically suspends a judge until Parliament determines whether the charges are valid. The organisations warned that suspending three senior Supreme Court justices could significantly affect the court’s functioning at a time when it is hearing important constitutional cases challenging government decisions and executive actions.

“Using or threatening to use impeachment against judges without clear constitutional justification risks creating the perception that constitutional procedures are being used to influence the composition of the court and potentially the outcome of pending cases,” the groups said.

They noted that Nepal has previously faced criticism over attempts to use impeachment proceedings against judges in ways that could compromise judicial independence.

“Public confidence in the judiciary depends not only on the competence and integrity of judges but also on the transparency, fairness and independence of judicial appointments,” said Meenakshi Ganguly, deputy Asia director at Human Rights Watch. “Appointments or removals that appear susceptible to political influence undermine confidence in the administration of justice and weaken the rule of law.”

International standards require judges to be protected from improper influence, pressure, threats and interference. The removal of judges must be based on objective criteria and safeguarded against political manipulation, the organisations said.

The groups acknowledged that judicial reform may be necessary in Nepal but said any reform process should strengthen institutional independence, transparency and accountability rather than increase political control over the judiciary.

“The objective of judicial reform should be to build stronger, more independent institutions that enjoy public confidence, not institutions that are more vulnerable to political pressure,” said Isabelle Lassee, acting regional director for South Asia at Amnesty International.

The organisations urged the Nepal government to stop “exerting pressure on judges to resign and avoid impeachment proceedings” unless there are clearly established constitutional grounds and due process safeguards.

They also called on authorities to ensure that judicial appointments, including the appointment of the chief justice, are conducted through transparent, objective and merit-based procedures.

The groups further urged Parliament to review amendments to the Constitutional Council Act through an open legislative process and ensure that future judicial reforms comply with Nepal’s constitution, the principles of separation of powers, and international standards on judicial independence.

समूहऽ न॑ कहलकै कि मई म॑ सरकार केरऽ संसदीय कानून के माध्यम स॑ नै बल्कि अध्यादेश के माध्यम स॑ संवैधानिक परिषद अधिनियम म॑ संशोधन करै के फैसला संवैधानिक सिद्धांतऽ के उल्लंघन करै छै आरू मुख्य न्यायाधीश सहित प्रमुख संवैधानिक निकायऽ म॑ अधिकारियऽ के नियुक्ति के प्रक्रिया के बारे म॑ चिंता व्यक्त करलऽ गेलऽ छै ।

संशोधन सँ प्रमुख संवैधानिक पद पर नियुक्ति के सिफारिश करय के जिम्मेवारी संवैधानिक परिषद् के कोरम आ मतदान के आवश्यकता मे बदलाव आयल अछि । अधिकार संगठन सब के कहनाय छनि जे एहि बदलाव सं न्यायिक नियुक्ति पर राजनीतिक प्रभाव के संभावना बढ़ल अछि किएक त परिषद मे सरकारी प्रतिनिधि के पास पहिने सं बहुमत अछि.

आईसीजे केरऽ वरिष्ठ कानूनी आरू नीति निदेशक इयान सेडरमैन न॑ बयान म॑ कहलकै कि न्यायपालिका केरऽ स्वतंत्रता कानून केरऽ राज केरऽ आधारशिला आरू मानव अधिकारऽ के सुरक्षा लेली एगो आवश्यक सुरक्षा छै । “नेपाल के न्याय व्यवस्था के कोनो सुधार न्यायालय के स्वतंत्रता, निष्पक्षता आ अखंडता के कमजोर नै, मजबूत करबाक चाही।”

समूह सब मनोज कुमार शर्मा के मुख्य न्यायाधीश के रूप में नियुक्ति पर सेहो सवाल उठेलक आ कहलक जे ई नेपाल के लंबा समय स चलल प्रथा स हटि गेल अछि जे ओ सबस वरिष्ठ न्यायाधीश के नियुक्ति करैत अछि।

हालांकि सुप्रीम कोर्ट मे तीनटा वरिष्ठ न्यायाधीश बनल छथि, मुदा संसदीय सुनवाई समिति क समर्थन क बाद शर्मा कए मुख्य न्यायाधीश नियुक्त कैल गेल। संस्था सब के कहनाय छनि जे हुनकर नामांकन के खिलाफ उठल शिकायत पर सार्थक जनजांच नहि कएल गेल अछि.

समूह सब के दावा छै कि ओकरा सब क॑ ई बात के विश्वसनीय रिपोर्ट मिललै कि सुप्रीम कोर्ट केरऽ तीन वरिष्ठ न्यायाधीश सपना प्रधान मल्ला, कुमार रेग्मी आरू हरि फुयाल प॑ महाभियोग के धमकी द॑ क॑ इस्तीफा दै के दबाव डाललऽ गेलऽ छै ।

ओ सब कहलनि जे, न्यायाधीश सब पर सार्वजनिक रूप स कोनो एहन आरोप के जानकारी नहि अछि जे महाभियोग के संवैधानिक आवश्यकता के पूरा करत।

नेपाल के संविधान के तहत महाभियोग के कार्यवाही शुरू भेला स कोनो न्यायाधीश के स्वतः निलंबित भ जायत अछि जा धरि संसद ई तय नै क लैत अछि जे आरोप वैध अछि कि नै। संगठन सब चेतावनी देलकै कि सुप्रीम कोर्ट केरऽ तीन वरिष्ठ न्यायाधीशऽ क॑ निलंबित करला स॑ कोर्ट केरऽ कामकाज प॑ काफी असर पड़॑ सकै छै, जब॑ कि ई सरकारी फैसला आरू कार्यकारी कार्रवाई क॑ चुनौती दै वाला महत्वपूर्ण संवैधानिक मामला के सुनवाई करी रहलऽ छै ।

समूह सब नँ कहलकै, “बिना स्पष्ट संवैधानिक औचित्य के न्यायाधीशौ के खिलाफ महाभियोग के उपयोग या उपयोग करै के धमकी देला स॑ ई धारणा पैदा होय के खतरा छै कि संवैधानिक प्रक्रिया के इस्तेमाल कोर्ट केरऽ संरचना आरू संभावित रूप स॑ लंबित मामला के परिणाम क॑ प्रभावित करै लेली करलऽ जाय रहलऽ छै ।

ओ सब नोट केलथि जे नेपाल मे एहि सं पहिने न्यायाधीश के खिलाफ महाभियोग के कार्यवाही के एहन तरीका सं उपयोग करय के कोशिश के लsक आलोचना के सामना करय पड़ल अछि जाहि सं न्यायिक स्वतंत्रता सं समझौता भ सकय.

ह्यूमन राइट्स वॉच केरऽ उप एशिया निदेशक मीनाक्षी गांगुली न॑ कहलकै कि न्यायपालिका प॑ जनविश्वास खाली न्यायाधीशऽ के योग्यता आरू ईमानदारी प॑ ही नै बल्कि न्यायिक नियुक्ति के पारदर्शिता, निष्पक्षता आरू स्वतंत्रता प॑ भी निर्भर करै छै । “राजनीतिक प्रभाव के शिकार प्रतीत होय वाला नियुक्ति या हटाबै स॑ न्याय के प्रशासन प॑ विश्वास कमजोर होय जाय छै आरू कानून के राज कमजोर होय जाय छै।”

अंतर्राष्ट्रीय मानक के अनुसार न्यायाधीश क॑ अनुचित प्रभाव, दबाव, धमकी आरू हस्तक्षेप स॑ बचाबै के जरूरत छै । न्यायाधीश सब के हटाबय के काज वस्तुनिष्ठ मानदंड के आधार पर होबाक चाही आ राजनीतिक हेरफेर स सुरक्षित हेबाक चाही संस्था सब कहलनि।

समूह सब नेपाल मे न्यायिक सुधार आवश्यक भ सकैत अछि से स्वीकार केलक मुदा कोनो सुधार प्रक्रिया न्यायपालिका पर राजनीतिक नियंत्रण बढ़ाबय के बजाय संस्थागत स्वतंत्रता, पारदर्शिता आ जवाबदेही के मजबूत करबाक चाही।

एम्नेस्टी इंटरनेशनल केरऽ दक्षिण एशिया केरऽ कार्यवाहक क्षेत्रीय निदेशक इसाबेल लसी न॑ कहलकै कि न्यायिक सुधार केरऽ उद्देश्य मजबूत, अधिक स्वतंत्र संस्थान के निर्माण होना होना चाहियऽ जेकरा म॑ जनविश्वास मिलै छै, न कि ऐसनऽ संस्था जे राजनीतिक दबाव के शिकार होय ।

संस्था सब नेपाल सरकार स आग्रह केलक जे जा धरि स्पष्ट रूप स स्थापित संवैधानिक आधार आ उचित प्रक्रिया क सुरक्षा नहि होएत ता धरि “न्यायाधीश पर इस्तीफा देबाक दबाव बनेनाइ आ महाभियोग क कार्यवाही स बचब” बंद करू।

हुनी अधिकारियौ स॑ ई भी आह्वान करलकै कि मुख्य न्यायाधीश केरऽ नियुक्ति सहित न्यायिक नियुक्ति पारदर्शी, वस्तुनिष्ठ आरू योग्यता आधारित प्रक्रिया के माध्यम स॑ करलऽ जाय ।

समूह सब आगू संसद स आग्रह केलक जे ओ खुला विधायी प्रक्रिया के माध्यम स संवैधानिक परिषद अधिनियम में संशोधन के समीक्षा करय आ भविष्य के न्यायिक सुधार नेपाल के संविधान, सत्ता के पृथक्करण के सिद्धांत, आ न्यायिक स्वतंत्रता के अंतर्राष्ट्रीय मानक के अनुपालन करय।

When Hira Shrestha of Khotang received the ‘Outstanding Woman Farmer’ award along with Rs 25,000 in cash on International Women’s Day 2025, she was overjoyed. “I was so happy to learn that farming in a village could also bring recognition,” she shared. Halesi Tuwachung Municipality had honored Hira for her contribution to marketing by growing vegetables and fruits in drought-ravaged fields. She is also grateful to the municipality for equipping her with irrigational and agricultural skills that helped her become an award-worthy farmer. “Had they not brought irrigation and agricultural training, there would have been no way to do commercial farming in this dry place,” she says.

Hira Shrestha with the certificate of honor. Photo - UNDP Nepal/ Robic Upadhyay

Despite having the Dudhkoshi and Sunkoshi rivers flowing next to the municipality, most of the land is drought-prone. In this municipality, the most drought-affected area in Khotang, there was a severe drinking water crisis until five years ago. But when elected representatives came to Halesi Tuwachung Municipality through the 2017 local level elections, they took on the responsibility of solving the drinking water problem. “Water had to be carried from far away, women and girls suffered greatly, lack of irrigation meant crops wouldn’t grow, food wasn’t enough for the whole year, and seasonal vegetables weren’t available,” recalls Mayor Bimala Rai, “we had to provide water to the people no matter what.” Bimala was the Deputy Mayor at that time. Local elected representatives had a comprehensive situation analysis of the municipality conducted in 2018. Through this, the reason for the water shortage in Halesi Tuwachung, situated at an elevation of up to 1,835 meters above sea level, was identified—due to low rainfall and steep rocky terrain, water ran off without underground recharge. This led to Halesi becoming the driest area in the entire district.” After discovering the cause of the drought, Halesi’s elected representatives began running to provincial and federal ministries to resolve the drinking water problem. The federal government listened heard their voices in 2020. Following that, a ‘Watershed-Based Climate Resilient Livelihoods' project was launched in collaboration with the Ministry of Forests and Environment and the United Nations Development Program (UNDP). The municipality and local residents became active in taking advantage of this project. Initially, water sources such as wells, stone spouts, and streams that were on the verge of disappearing in the area were revived through maintenance and repair. Locals got the opportunity to learn skills in rainwater harvesting for ponds, tunnels, and commercial farming along with fruit and vegetable seeds.

Dil Kumari Rai of Moli village in Okhaldhunga helps her neighbours cultivate crops inside a tunnel. Photo - UNDP Nepal/ Robic Upadhyay

Now many homes i the municipality have ponds to collect rainwater. Local farmers use the water collected in these ponds for drip irrigation to grow off-season vegetables. Due to this, they have succeeded in earning an income without having to leave their homes. Among them, 40-year-old Hira of Halesi Tuwachung Municipality-9 has established herself as a successful woman entrepreneur by engaging in commercial farming. Through this she also helped her husband avoid going abroad to support the family. In 2025, the Hira and Bharat earned Rs 200,000 from vegetable farming and an additional Rs 45,000 from raising livestock. “There has been a change in life that I never imagined,” says Hira, “since the municipality head is a woman herself, it is easier for us to ask for programs and plans, and we have been able to earn income from home.” Rice cultivation in the Majhi settlement of Halesi Tuwachung Municipality had not flourished due to a lack of sufficient water supply. However, the solar lifting irrigation introduced by UNDP's 'Developing Climate Resilient Livelihoods' has led to an increase in the production of rice. The municipality distributed corrugated iron sheets to 112 families whose roofs were unsuitable for building ponds and collecting water. This made rainwater harvesting easier.

Bimala Pariyar of Tinpiple in Okhaldhunga attending to her livestock. Photo - UNDP Nepal/ Robic Upadhyay

After water became available, the municipality has also distributed hand tractors to women in households whose male members have gone abroad or moved to cities. Additionally, buffaloes have been provided as subsidies under shed improvement support to increase agricultural yield. The combination of farming and animal husbandry has brought visible change to farmers’ lives. Halesi Tuwachung Municipalitys' Mayor Rai says "If the municipality had to do it alone, it would have been impossible to handle the technical aspects, commercial farming expansion, and community development all at once.” She says, “UNDP’s support has reduced that burden to zero.” Indeed, the project with a total cost of USD 7.9 million (more than Rs 1 billion) has benefited eight local units in Khotang and Okhaldhunga, including Halesi Tuwachung, which falls in the lower Dudhkoshi watershed area. A municipal-level agricultural strategic plan has also been prepared to continue the efforts initiated through the project. An agriculture mart and a cold storage center have been established in the Halesi market. An agro-vet center is in operation to diagnose diseases affecting crops, livestock, fertilizers, and seeds. Mayor Rai says, “The municipality works to fulfill whatever need exists here.” Good practices are being replicated The work done by municipalities is not limited to just one place or area. Local governments have replicated the good practices in various parts of the country. Six years ago, a 380-kilowatt hydropower plant built under a renewable energy program for rural livelihoods on the Tara Khola in Baglung district with support from UNDP brought electricity access to more than 2,000 households in Tara Khola Rural Municipality. However, when consumers had to walk for hours to reach the office to pay electricity bills due to geographical difficulties, some found it burdensome. For the convenience of the community members, smart electricity meters were been installed in coordination between the rural municipality and the electricity office. The electricity office installed meters in every consumer’s home and the rural municipality appointed sub-dealers in all wards for recharge card distribution. Due to this, for the first time in the district, Tara Khola hydropower consumers have received smart recharge meters at home. Om Gharti of Sip village, Tara Khola-5, says, “We no longer have to rush to pay 100/200 rupee bills. Our village has city-like facilities.”

Women in Tara Khola work on a potato chips factory powered by the 380-kilowatt Tara Khola hydropower plant. Photo - UNDP Nepal/ Suraj Ratna Shakya

अंतरराष्ट्रीय महिला दिवस 2025 पर खोटांग के हीरा श्रेष्ठ के जखन ‘उत्कृष्ट महिला किसान’ पुरस्कार के संग 25 हजार रुपैया नगद भेटल त हुनका बहुत खुशी भेल। ओ साझा केलनि जे, ई जानि कए हमरा एतेक खुशी भेल जे कोनो गाम मे खेती सेहो पहचान ल सकैत अछि। हलेसी तुवाचुंग नगरपालिका रौदीसँ तबाह खेतमे तरकारी आ फल उगाबैत विपणनमे हिराके योगदानक लेल सम्मानित केने छल । ओ नगरपालिका के सेहो आभारी छथि जे हुनका सिंचाई आ कृषि कौशल स लैस केलक जे हुनका पुरस्कृत किसान बनय मे मदद केलक। ओ कहैत छथि जे अगर ओ सब सिंचाई आ कृषि प्रशिक्षण नहि अनने रहितथि त एहि शुष्क जगह पर व्यावसायिक खेती करबाक कोनो तरीका नहि रहैत।

हीरा श्रेष्ठ सम्मान प्रमाण पत्र के साथ। फोटो - यूएनडीपी नेपाल/ रोबिक उपाध्याय

नगरपालिकाक बगलमे दुधकोशी आ सुनकोशी नदी बहैत रहलाक बादो अधिकांश जमीन रौदीक प्रवण अछि । खोटांग के सबस बेसी रौदी प्रभावित इलाका एहि नगरपालिका मे पांच साल पहिने तक पेयजल के भयंकर संकट छल। लेकिन २०१७ के स्थानीय तह के चुनाव के माध्यम स॑ जब॑ निर्वाचित प्रतिनिधि हलेसी तुवाचुंग नगरपालिका म॑ ऐलै त॑ पेयजल के समस्या के समाधान के जिम्मेदारी लेलकै । मेयर विमला राय स्मरण करैत कहैत छथि, “पानि दूर सँ ल’ जेबाक छल, महिला आ लड़की केँ बहुत नुकसान भेल, सिंचाईक अभाव मे फसल नहि उगय लागल, साल भरि लेल भोजन पर्याप्त नहि छल, आ मौसमी तरकारी नहि भेटैत छल, हमरा लोकनि केँ लोक केँ पानि उपलब्ध कराबय पड़ल चाहे किछुओ हो।” ओहि समय मे विमला डिप्टी मेयर छलीह। स्थानीय निर्वाचित प्रतिनिधि सब के पास 2018 में नगरपालिका के व्यापक स्थिति विश्लेषण छेलै.एकर माध्यम स॑ समुद्र तल स॑ १,८३५ मीटर तलक के ऊंचाई प॑ स्थित हलेसी तुवाचुंग म॑ पानी के कमी के कारण के पहचान करलऽ गेलै-कम बारिश आरू खड़ी चट्टानी इलाका के कारण बिना भूमिगत रिचार्ज के पानी भागी गेलै । एहि सँ हलेसी पूरा जिला मे सबसँ शुष्क क्षेत्र बनि गेल।” सूखा के कारण के पता चलला के बाद हलेसी के निर्वाचित प्रतिनिधि पेयजल के समस्या के समाधान के लेल प्रांतीय आ संघीय मंत्रालय में दौड़य लगलाह. संघीय सरकार 2020 मे सुनल गेल ओकर आवाज सुनलक.एकर बाद वन आ पर्यावरण मंत्रालय आ संयुक्त राष्ट्र विकास कार्यक्रम (यूएनडीपी) कें सहयोग सं ‘जल विभाजन आधारित जलवायु लचीला आजीविका’ परियोजना शुरू कैल गेलय. एहि परियोजना क लाभ उठाबय मे नगरपालिका आ स्थानीय निवासी सक्रिय भ गेल। शुरू में जल स्रोत जेना इनार, पाथर के टोंटी, आ धारक जे एहि इलाका में गायब होय के कगार पर छल, ओकरा रखरखाव आ मरम्मत के माध्यम सं पुनर्जीवित कयल गेल. स्थानीय लोक के फल-सब्जी के बीज के संग-संग पोखरि... सुरंग, आओर व्यावसायिक खेती के लेल बरसात के पानि संचय के हुनर सीखय के मौका मिलल.

ओखलढुंगा के मोली गाम के दिल कुमारी राय अपन पड़ोसी के सुरंग के अंदर फसल के खेती में मदद करैत छैथ। फोटो - यूएनडीपी नेपाल/ रोबिक उपाध्याय

आब कतेको घर i नगरपालिका मे बरसातक पानि जमा करबाक लेल पोखरि अछि । स्थानीय किसान अइ पोखरि मे एकत्रित पानी कें उपयोग ड्रिप इरिगेशन कें लेल ऑफ सीजन तरकारी कें खेती कें लेल करय छै. एकरऽ वजह स॑ घरऽ स॑ बाहर नै निकललऽ आय कमाबै म॑ सफल होय गेलऽ छै । एहि मे हलेसी तुवाचुंग नगरपालिका–९ के ४० वर्षीय हीरा व्यावसायिक खेती मे लागि सफल महिला उद्यमी के रूप मे अपना के स्थापित केने छथि । एहि माध्यमे ओ अपन पति कए सेहो परिवार क भरण-पोषण लेल विदेश जेबा स बचबा मे मदद केलथि। 2025 मे हीरा आ भारत कए सब्जी खेती स दू लाख आ पशुपालन स अतिरिक्त 45 हजार टका क कमाई भेल। हीरा कहैत छथि, “जीवन मे एहन बदलाव आयल अछि जेकर कल्पना हम कहियो नहि केने रही, चूँकि नगरपालिका प्रमुख स्वयं महिला छथि, ताहि लेल हमरा सब लेल कार्यक्रम आ योजना मांगब आसान भ गेल अछि, आ घर बैसल आमदनी सेहो भ सकल अछि।” हलेसी तुवाचुङ नगरपालिकाके माझी बस्तीमे पर्याप्त जल आपूर्तिके अभावमे धानक खेती पनपने नहि छल । लेकिन यूएनडीपी केरऽ ‘विकसित जलवायु लचीला आजीविका’ द्वारा शुरू करलऽ गेलऽ सौर उत्थान सिंचाई के वजह स॑ चावल केरऽ उत्पादन म॑ वृद्धि होय गेलऽ छै । नगरपालिका 112 परिवार के नालीदार लोहा के चादर वितरित केलक जेकर छत पोखरि बनेबा आ पानि संग्रहण के लेल अनुपयुक्त छल। एहि स बरसात क पानि क संग्रहण मे आसानी भ गेल।

ओखलढुंगा के तिनपिपल के बिमला परियार अपन पशुधन के देखभाल करैत। फोटो - यूएनडीपी नेपाल/ रोबिक उपाध्याय

पानि मिलला के बाद नगरपालिका ओहि घर मे महिला के हाथ ट्रैक्टर सेहो वितरण केने अछि जकर पुरुष सदस्य विदेश गेल अछि या शहर चलि गेल अछि। एकर अतिरिक्त कृषि पैदावार मे वृद्धि कें लेल शेड सुधार समर्थन कें तहत सब्सिडी कें रूप मे भैंस कें उपलब्ध करायल गेल छै. खेती आ पशुपालन के संयोजन स किसान के जीवन में दृश्यमान परिवर्तन आयल अछि | हलेसी तुवाचुंग नगरपालिकाक मेयर राय कहैत छथि "जँ नगरपालिका केँ असगर करय पड़ितैक त' तकनीकी पहलू, वाणिज्यिक खेती विस्तार, आ सामुदायिक विकास केँ एकहि बेर मे सम्हारब असंभव रहैत।" ओ कहैत छथि, “यूएनडीपी के समर्थन सं ओ बोझ शून्य भ गेल अछि.” दरअसल, कुल 79 लाख डॉलर (1 अरब रुपया स॑ भी अधिक) के लागत वाला ई परियोजना स॑ खोटांग आरू ओखलढुंगा केरऽ आठ स्थानीय इकाइयऽ क॑ फायदा मिललऽ छै, जेकरा म॑ हलेसी तुवाचुंग भी शामिल छै, जे निचला दुधकोशी जल विभाजन क्षेत्र म॑ पड़ै छै । एहि परियोजना क माध्यम स शुरू कैल गेल प्रयास कए जारी रखबा लेल नगर स्तरीय कृषि रणनीतिक योजना सेहो तैयार कैल गेल अछि। हलेसी बाजार मे कृषि मार्ट आ कोल्ड स्टोरेज सेंटर क स्थापना कैल गेल अछि। फसल, पशुधन, खाद, आ बीज कें द्वारा कयल गेल काज मात्र एक स्थान वा क्षेत्र धरि सीमित नहि अछि । स्थानीय सरकार देश के विभिन्न भाग मे नीक प्रथा के नकल केलक अछि। छह साल पहिने यूएनडीपी के सहयोग सं बागलुंग जिला के तारा खोला पर ग्रामीण Nepal is planning to tighten the rules for climbing Mount Everest as lawmakers push sweeping reforms aimed at improving safety, reducing overcrowding, and protecting the fragile Himalayan environment. The proposed legislation comes after a record-breaking climbing season that saw more than 1,000 successful ascents from the Nepal side of Everest, along with several fatalities, reigniting concerns over congestion on the world’s highest peak.

Fifty-eight lawmakers have jointly registered 263 amendments under House Rule 114 to the bill, which was passed by the National Assembly in February and is now under review. The proposals specifically target eligibility criteria and operational controls for expeditions on Mt Everest and other 8,000-metre peaks.

Climbers push through extreme altitude above 8,000 metres, facing thin air and cold. (Image: Pexels)

Stricter Eligibility for Everest Climbers

If the bill is approved, the new law would significantly raise the bar for aspiring Everest climbers by requiring them to first prove their high-altitude mountaineering experience before obtaining a permit.

One of the biggest changes in the proposed legislation is that climbers would need to successfully summit at least one mountain above 7,000 metres in Nepal before becoming eligible for an Everest permit. The move is intended to ensure that only experienced climbers attempt the world’s tallest mountain.

The proposal also includes stricter regulations for expedition operators and guides. High-altitude guides accompanying climbers on Everest would be required to be Nepali citizens, a measure designed to promote local expertise and improve safety standards on expeditions.

The reforms come in response to growing criticism over overcrowding on Everest. During the latest spring climbing season, Nepal issued 492 climbing permits, resulting in 1,008 successful ascents from the Nepal side for the first time in history.

Long queues near the summit have become a recurring concern, with climbers often forced to wait in the so-called “death zone", where oxygen levels are extremely low. Experts have repeatedly warned that congestion, combined with inexperienced climbers, can increase the risk of accidents and fatalities.

Impact on Nepal’s Tourism Industry

Mountaineering is a major contributor to Nepal’s tourism economy, with Everest attracting climbers from across the globe every year. However, balancing tourism revenue with environmental protection and climber safety has become increasingly challenging as commercial expeditions continue to grow.

एवरेस्ट पर्वतारोही के लिये सख्त पात्रता

अगर ई विधेयक क॑ मंजूरी मिल॑ छै त॑ ई नया कानून स॑ एवरेस्ट पर्वतारोही केरऽ आकांक्षी लेली बार काफी बढ़ी जैतै, जेकरा म॑ ओकरा परमिट लेबै स॑ पहल॑ पहल॑ अपनऽ उच्च ऊंचाई प॑ पर्वतारोहण के अनुभव साबित करै के जरूरत होतै ।

प्रस्तावित कानून मे एकटा पैघ बदलाव इ अछि जे पर्वतारोही कए एवरेस्ट परमिट क पात्र हेबा स पहिने नेपाल मे कम स कम 7000 मीटर स ऊपर क एकटा पहाड़ क सफलतापूर्वक शिखर पर पहुंचबाक जरूरत होएत। ई कदम के उद्देश्य ई सुनिश्चित करना छै कि अनुभवी पर्वतारोही ही दुनिया केरऽ सबस॑ ऊँचऽ पहाड़ केरऽ प्रयास करै ।

एहि प्रस्ताव मे अभियान संचालक आ गाइड क लेल सख्त नियम सेहो शामिल अछि। एवरेस्ट पर पर्वतारोही के साथ जाय वाला उच्च ऊंचाई वाला गाइड के नेपाली नागरिक होना जरूरी होतै, जे स्थानीय विशेषज्ञता के बढ़ावा दै आरू अभियान पर सुरक्षा मानक में सुधार लेली बनालौ गेलौ उपाय छै ।

full_article:
Samsung Nepal has announced the successful completion of the latest Samsung Innovation Campus (SIC) Coding & Programming programme and opened applications for a new Artificial Intelligence (AI) course, strengthening its commitment to developing Nepal’s next generation of digital talent.

The Coding & Programming course under SIC, conducted from December 22, 2025, to June 30, 2026, equipped students with hands-on technical skills, practical project experience and industry exposure. Graduates were honoured at a ceremony recognising their successful completion of the programme.

“When I attended Samsung Innovation Campus shortly after arriving in Nepal last December, I saw tremendous potential in Nepal’s young talent. Today, I am proud to see that potential turning into real achievement. As artificial intelligence reshapes every industry, developing digital talent is more important than ever. Through Samsung Innovation Campus, Samsung is equipping young people with the skills, confidence and innovative mindset to help lead Nepal’s digital future,” said Chang Uk Jung, Managing Director, Samsung Nepal.

Launched in Nepal in 2023 under Samsung’s global CSR vision, “Together for Tomorrow! Enabling People,” Samsung Innovation Campus equips young people with industry-relevant skills in emerging technologies while strengthening essential workplace capabilities such as communication, collaboration and critical thinking.

The new AI programme comes as artificial intelligence is transforming industries and creating demand for a new generation of digital professionals. Designed around practical learning and real-world applications, the course will help participants build AI capabilities while encouraging innovation to address Nepal’s evolving development needs.

Beyond the classroom, Samsung Nepal will continue supporting graduates through mentorship from Samsung employees and industry experts, innovation projects and career guidance. The company also plans to establish a Samsung Innovation Campus Alumni Network, enabling graduates to stay connected, continue learning and mentor future participants.

Samsung believes stronger collaboration between academia, industry and government will be essential to building Nepal’s AI ecosystem, expanding career opportunities and accelerating the country’s digital transformation.

full_article:
KATHMANDU: Police said 47 foreign women have been deported from Nepal for allegedly engaging in prostitution.

The District Police Range, Kathmandu, disclosed the information during a press conference on Friday.

Speaking at the briefing, Superintendent of Police (SP) Pawan Kumar Bhattarai said 57 foreign women were detained during a special operation in tourist areas, including Thamel and Durbar Marg, on suspicion of involvement in prostitution.

Of those detained, 47 have been deported through the Department of Immigration, while investigations into the remaining 10 are ongoing, he said.

title: Third Meeting of the Nepal-Australia Bilateral Consultation Mechanism (BCM) - Ministry of Foreign Affairs Nepal
description: Third Meeting of the Nepal-Australia Bilateral Consultation Mechanism (BCM)  Ministry of Foreign Affairs Nepal
publisher.title: Ministry of Foreign Affairs Nepal
full_article:
Press Release

The Third Meeting of the Nepal-Australia Bilateral Consultation Mechanism (BCM) concluded in Kathmandu today.

The two sides reviewed the status of Nepal- Australia bilateral relations and deliberated on matters of mutual interests.

Both sides reaffirmed their commitment to translating the understandings reached between the two sides into tangible outcomes for the mutual benefit of both countries.

They reviewed bilateral cooperation and development assistance, focusing on priorities such as high-level political engagement, climate resilience, green economy, water resource management, agricultural research, and the alignment of Australia's Development Partnership Plan in line with Nepal's national priorities.

The BCM highlighted various areas of cooperation, including the expansion of trade relations, air connectivity, tourism, investment in Nepal's hydropower sector and the establishment of a formal educational cooperation framework for education and research.

The meeting also focused on strengthening people-to-people links by leveraging diaspora networks, managing migration and visa frameworks and exploring sister-city relations.

Both sides also exchanged views on regional and international trends, human rights, carbon trading frameworks and reciprocal support for candidacies in multilateral forums like the United Nations.

The meeting was co-chaired by Mr Amrit Bahadur Rai, Foreign Secretary of the Ministry and H. E. Ms Sarah Storey, First Assistant Secretary of the South and Central Asia Division at the Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT) of Australia.

The Australian delegation comprised Ms Margot Holt, Policy Officer (DFAT); Mr Simon Ernst, Head of Mission and Mr Greg Klemm, Deputy Head of Mission at the Australian Embassy in Kathmandu; Mr Dylan Jones-Virma, First Secretary Development at the Australian Embassy; Mr Steven Biddle, Regional Director for South Asia at the Department of Home Affairs; Lt Col Fiona Bruce, Army Adviser / Brigadier Damian Hill, Head of Australian DefenceStaff; and Mr George Thiveos, Minister-Counsellor (Education and Research) at the Australian High Commission in India.

The Nepali side consisted of Mr. Prakash Adhikari, Joint Secretary and Head of the South-East Asia and the Pacific Division from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs; Mr Dhani Ram Sharma, Joint Secretary, Ministry of Finance; Mr Ananda Kafle, Joint Secretary, Ministry of Home Affairs; Mr Buddha Bahadur Gurung, Joint Secretary, Ministry of Industry, Commerce and Supplies; Dr Hari Bahadur KC, Joint Secretary, and Dr Rajendra KC, Joint Secretary from the Ministry of Agriculture, Forests and Environment; Mr Shiva Kumar Sapkota, Joint Secretary, Ministry of Education and Sports; Mr. Jeebachh Mandal, Joint Secretary, Water and Energy Commission Secretariat; Mr. Narayan Prasad Wagle and Mr. Binod Mukhiya, Under Secretaries and Mr Hemant Timilsina, Section Officer from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

Similarly, the first meeting of Joint Nepal-Australia Trade and Investment Committee under the Nepal Australia Trade and Investment Framework Arrangement (TIFA) was held in Kathmandu, yesterday.

The Bilateral Consultation Mechanism between Nepal and Australia was established in July 2017. The first and second meeting of the Mechanism were held in Kathmandu and Canberra in 2018 and 2022 respectively.

बैठक म॑ प्रवासी नेटवर्क केरऽ लाभ उठाबै, प्रवास आरू वीजा केरऽ ढाँचा के प्रबंधन आरू बहिन-शहर संबंधऽ के खोज करी क॑ लोगऽ स॑ लोगऽ के संबंध क॑ मजबूत करै प॑ भी ध्यान देलऽ गेलै ।

दूनू पक्ष न॑ क्षेत्रीय आरू अंतर्राष्ट्रीय प्रवृत्ति, मानव अधिकार, कार्बन व्यापार केरऽ ढाँचा आरू संयुक्त राष्ट्र जैसनऽ बहुपक्षीय मंचऽ म॑ उम्मीदवारी लेली पारस्परिक समर्थन प॑ भी विचार के आदान-प्रदान करलकै ।

बैठक केरऽ सह-अध्यक्षता मंत्रालय केरऽ विदेश सचिव श्री अमृत बहादुर राय आरू ऑस्ट्रेलिया केरऽ विदेश आरू व्यापार विभाग (डीएफएटी) म॑ दक्षिण आरू मध्य एशिया प्रभाग केरऽ प्रथम सहायक सचिव एच. ई. सुश्री सारा स्टोरी न॑ करलकै ।

ऑस्ट्रेलियाई प्रतिनिधिमंडल मे नीति अधिकारी (डीएफएटी) सुश्री मार्गोट होल्ट; काठमांडू मे ऑस्ट्रेलियाई दूतावास मे मिशन प्रमुख श्री साइमन अर्नस्ट आ मिशन उप प्रमुख श्री ग्रेग क्लेम; ऑस्ट्रेलियाई दूतावास के प्रथम सचिव विकास श्री डायलन जोन्स-विर्मा; गृह विभाग के दक्षिण एशिया के क्षेत्रीय निदेशक श्री स्टीवन बिडल; लेफ्टिनेंट कर्नल फियोना ब्रूस, सेना सलाहकार / ब्रिगेडियर डेमियन हिल, ऑस्ट्रेलियाई रक्षाकर्मी के प्रमुख; आरू भारत म॑ ऑस्ट्रेलियाई उच्चायोग केरऽ मंत्री-परामर्शदाता (शिक्षा आरू अनुसंधान) श्री जॉर्ज थिवेओस ।

नेपाली पक्षमे विदेश मन्त्रालयसँ संयुक्त सचिव आ दक्षिण पूर्व एशिया आ प्रशांत प्रभागक प्रमुख श्री प्रकाश अधिकारी; वित्त मंत्रालय के संयुक्त सचिव श्री धनी राम शर्मा, प्रो. श्री आनंद काफ्ले, गृह मंत्रालय के संयुक्त सचिव, प्रो. श्री बुद्ध बहादुर गुरुंग, संयुक्त सचिव, उद्योग, वाणिज्य एवं आपूर्ति मंत्रालय, प्रो. कृषि, वन एवं पर्यावरण मंत्रालय से संयुक्त सचिव डॉ हरि बहादुर केसी, एवं संयुक्त सचिव डॉ. राजेन्द्र केसी; श्री शिव कुमार सापकोटा, संयुक्त सचिव, शिक्षा एवं खेल मंत्रालय, प्रो. श्री जीबछ मंडल, संयुक्त सचिव, जल एवं ऊर्जा आयोग सचिवालय; श्री नारायण प्रसाद वागले एवं श्री बिनोद मुखिया, अवर सचिव एवं श्री हेमंत तिमिलसिना, विदेश मंत्रालय से अनुभाग अधिकारी |

तहिना नेपाल आस्ट्रेलिया व्यापार तथा निवेश ढाँचा व्यवस्था अन्तर्गत नेपाल आस्ट्रेलिया व्यापार तथा निवेश समितिके पहिल बैसार काठमाण्डौमे, काल्हि सम्पन्न भेल अछि ।

नेपाल आ ऑस्ट्रेलिया के बीच द्विपक्षीय परामर्श तंत्र के स्थापना जुलाई २०१७ मे भेल छल ।तन्त्र के पहिल आ दोसर बैसार क्रमशः २०१८ आ २०२२ मे काठमांडू आ कैनबरा मे भेल छल ।

full_article:
The RSP swept the election four month ago, benefiting from widespread public disillusionment with the past 20 years of misrule and poor governance by the old parties.

That was a vote for a departure from the past. And there were great expectations. Expectations can be unrealistic, but they stem from the hope. Decades of political dysfunction cannot be solved in months, but there are now signs of impatience in the public.

There are many who want to give this government a chance to set things right, but its high-handedness is putting too many people off.

Prime Minister Balendra Shah's government and his advisers seem to be resorting to distraction and deflection. Balendra Shah expected to win, but not with such a huge majority, so he is letting his advisers behave in the only way they know how — with tough talk, intimidation, and bypassing due process.

Instead of strengthening coordination and communication between line agencies, members of the PMO have been acting like a parallel government.

A widely-circulated investigation in setopati.com by editor Ameet Dhakal has meticulously detailed how the prime minister’s inner circle threatened officials, including the DG of the Passport Department Tirtha Raj Aryal and its IT director Sunil KC to cancel German e-passport deal. The CIAA chief Prem Kumar Rai was held hostage for hours in a PMO anteroom.

Also present were Foreign Secretary Amrit Rai and German Ambassador Udo Eugen Volz who were needlessly questioned and harassed for hours, Dhakal quoted sources as saying. Even when reminded that it would cost the country dearly, diplomatically and legally, they ordered proceedings against two German companies and 15 others.

Last year, the Nepal government awarded German companies Veridos GmbH and Mühlbauer ID Services a five-year contract worth Rs10.13 billion to arrange 6.4 million e-passports. The Department of Passports is alleged to have manipulated the procurement process to award the contract to the Germans.

The French company IDEMIA supplied Nepal’s machine-readable passports and e-passports until last year, losing the bid to Veridos GmbH and Mühlbauer ID Services after 17 years. IDEMIA challenged the decision in court but the Public Procurement Review Committee dismissed it. The French firm itself is alleged to have bypassed the Public Procurement Act through bribery, and the action against the Germans is seen as a retribution for losing the contract.

‘The way constitutional officials and state administrators were berated exceeding all constitutional bounds inside the Prime Minister's Office on 15 June over the passport procurement case is a troubling sign of a government run by a tight inner circle,” Dhakal later wrote in an editorial.

He continued: “By discarding established governance norms and democratic principles, the Prime Minister’s Secretariat operated like a shadow cabinet. Its chief qualification wasn't administrative competence, but the blind impulse of populism and an arrogant 'we know it all' mindset.”

The prime minister’s vocal supporters have applauded his move to thumb its nose at what they believe was a tainted deal by a previous government. They blame the messenger for exposing the bungling.

Bypassing the Foreign Ministry and acting without constitutional jurisdiction or formal expertise has harmed Nepal’s credibility in the international arena, and shown once again how feckless and fickle the PM’s advisers have been.

Evidence is growing that Balendra Shah and his kitchen cabinet are working to undermine the state mechanism, driven partly by their belief that two-thirds is mandate to uproot everything.

From the eviction of squatters to bungling international relations, Nepal is paying too high a price for signs of change that ordinary citizens have not yet seen. The last straw for many was the 3% equity tax on private healthcare and education. The prime minister appears to have read the writing on the wall and rolled it back (page 1).

The government had also proposed the Vehicle and Transport Management Bill, which introduced significantly harder penalties for traffic violations with fines up to Rs100,000, before the self-immolation of Ganesh Nepali after repeated traffic fines for illegal parking. To deflect scrutiny, supporters of the Balendra Shah government illegally parked their cars in front of select media houses, an act later condemned by their own party.

These recent cases show that one hand of government doesn’t know what the other hand is doing. Nearly four months into the RSP government, the cracks in the party’s formidable armour are beginning to show.

Everything came to a head this week with fresh rumours of the prime minister preparing to sack Finance Minister Swarnim Wagle over ideological and policy differences. Wagle’s equity tax was ill-advised in a country where those seeking private schools or hospitals are not necessarily the wealthy.

The Rabi-Swarnim chat at the Dustin Thani seems to have resolved the issue for now. It now remains to be seen how long party chair Rabi Lamichhane can keep doing damage control and keep the RSP together for the next five years. There are seemingly irreconcilable differences in personality and working style between the party and the PMO.

Feedback about international relations seems to be getting across to the prime minister who is finally meeting Indian and Chinese envoys separately later this week. He has also been holding consultations with the business sector.

The hope is that the PMO and the RSP will come together as they did during the election campaign and show greater accountability for their own good. Failure is not an option for the country, either.

पिछला 20 साल स पुरान दल क कुशासन आ खराब शासन स व्यापक जन मोहभंग स फायदा उठा कए आरएसपा चारि मास पहिने चुनाव मे झाड़ू लगा देलक।

जे अतीत स अलग हेबाक वोट छल। आ बहुत पैघ उम्मीद सेहो छल। अपेक्षा अवास्तविक भ सकैत अछि, मुदा ओ आशा स उपजल अछि। दशकों स राजनीतिक विकार महीनों मे नहि सुलझल जा सकैत अछि, मुदा आब जनता मे अधीरता क संकेत देखबा मे आबि रहल अछि।

बहुतो एहन छथिन्ह जे एहि सरकार के बात के ठीक करय के मौका देबय चाहय छथिन्ह मुदा एकर हाई-हैंडपन बेसि लोक के टालि रहल अछि.

प्रधानमंत्री बलेन्द्र शाह के सरकार आओर हुनकर सलाहकार विकर्षण आओर विक्षेप के सहारा ल रहल देखा रहल छथिन्ह. बलेन्द्र शाह क॑ जीत के उम्मीद छेलै, लेकिन एतना विशाल बहुमत के साथ नै, ई लेली वू अपनऽ सलाहकारऽ क॑ एकमात्र तरीका स॑ व्यवहार करै ल॑ द॑ रहलऽ छै जेकरा स॑ ओकरा पता छै — कठोर बात, धमकी, आरू उचित प्रक्रिया क॑ बाईपास करी क॑ ।

लाइन एजेंसी के बीच समन्वय आ संचार मजबूत करय के बजाय पीएमओ के सदस्य समानांतर सरकार के तरह काज करैत आबि रहल छथिन्ह.

संपादक अमीत ढकाल द्वारा setopati.com पर व्यापक रूप स॑ प्रसारित जांच म॑ बहुत सावधानी स॑ बतैलऽ गेलऽ छै कि कोना प्रधानमंत्री केरऽ भीतरी घेरा न॑ पासपोर्ट विभाग केरऽ डीजी तीर्थराज अर्यल आरू ओकरऽ आईटी निदेशक सुनील केसी सहित अधिकारियऽ क॑ जर्मन ई-पासपोर्ट सौदा रद्द करै के धमकी देलकै । सीआईएए के प्रमुख प्रेम कुमार राय के पीएमओ के एंटीरूम में घंटों बंधक बना क राखल गेल छल।

सूत्रऽ के हवाला स॑ ढकाल न॑ कहलकै कि विदेश सचिव अमृत राय आरू जर्मनी केरऽ राजदूत उडो यूजेन वोल्ज भी मौजूद छेलै जेकरा स॑ घंटों तलक बेवजह पूछताछ आरू परेशान करलऽ गेलै । जखन मोन पाड़ल गेल जे एहि स देश कए महग, कूटनीतिक आ कानूनी रूप स नुकसान होएत, तखनो ओ सब दूटा जर्मन कंपनी आ 15टा कंपनी क खिलाफ कार्रवाई क आदेश देलथि।

पिछला साल नेपाल सरकार जर्मन कंपनी वेरिडोस जीएमबीएच आ मुहलबाउर आईडी सर्विसेज कए 64 लाख ई-पासपोर्ट क व्यवस्था करबा लेल 10.13 अरब टका क पांच साल क ठेका देलक अछि। आरोप छै कि पासपोर्ट विभाग न॑ खरीद प्रक्रिया म॑ हेरफेर करी क॑ जर्मनी क॑ ई ठेका देल॑ छै ।

फ्रांस के कंपनी आईडीईएमआईए पिछला साल तक नेपाल के मशीन सं पढ़य योग्य पासपोर्ट आओर ई-पासपोर्ट के आपूर्ति केलक, जाहि सं 17 साल बाद वेरिडोस जीएमबीएच आओर मुहलबाउर आईडी सर्विसेज सं बोली हार गेल. आईडीईएमआईए एहि फैसला कए कोर्ट मे चुनौती देलक मुदा लोक खरीद समीक्षा समिति एकरा खारिज क देलक। आरोप छै कि फ्रांसीसी फर्म न॑ खुद घूसखोरी के माध्यम स॑ सार्वजनिक खरीद अधिनियम क॑ बाईपास करी देलकै, आरू जर्मनी के खिलाफ ई कार्रवाई क॑ अनुबंध हारला के बदला के रूप म॑ देखलऽ जाय छै ।

बाद मँ ढकल नँ एगो संपादकीय मँ लिखलकै, ‘पासपोर्ट खरीद के मामला मँ १५ जून क प्रधानमंत्री कार्यालय के भीतर संवैधानिक अधिकारियौ आरू राज्य प्रशासकौ क सब संवैधानिक सीमा पार करी क जे तरह स॑ डांटलऽ गेलै, वू कड़ा भीतरी घेरा द्वारा संचालित सरकार के परेशान करै वाला संकेत छै ।

हुनी आगू कहलकै, “स्थापित शासन मानदंड आरू लोकतांत्रिक सिद्धांत क त्याग करी क प्रधानमंत्री सचिवालय छाया मंत्रिमंडल के तरह संचालित छेलै । एकरऽ मुख्य योग्यता प्रशासनिक योग्यता नै छेलै, बल्कि लोकवाद केरऽ आन्हर आवेग आरू अहंकारी ‘हमरा सब क॑ पता छै’ मानसिकता छेलै।”

प्रधानमंत्री केरऽ मुखर समर्थक न॑ हुनकऽ ई कदम प॑ तारीफ करलकै कि हुनी ई बात प॑ नाक के अंगूठा लगाबै के कोशिश करलकै जेकरा हुनकऽ मानना छै कि ई एगो पिछला सरकार केरऽ दागदार सौदा छेलै । बंगलिंग के उजागर करय लेल दूत के दोषी ठहराबैत छथिन्ह.

विदेश मंत्रालय क॑ बाईपास करी क॑ बिना संवैधानिक अधिकार क्षेत्र या औपचारिक विशेषज्ञता के काम करला स॑ अंतरराष्ट्रीय क्षेत्र म॑ नेपाल केरऽ विश्वसनीयता क॑ नुकसान पहुँचलऽ छै, आरू एक बार फेरू ई देखाबै छै कि पीएम केरऽ सलाहकार कतेक बेढंगा आरू चंचल रहलऽ छै ।

सबूत बढ़ी रहलऽ छै कि बलेन्द्र शाह आरू हुनकऽ किचन कैबिनेट राज्य केरऽ तंत्र क॑ कमजोर करै के काम करी रहलऽ छै, जेकरऽ कुछ हद तलक ई मान्यता स॑ प्रेरित छै कि दू तिहाई सब कुछ उखाड़ै के जनादेश छै ।

सुकून के बेदखली स ल कए अंतरराष्ट्रीय संबंध मे गडबड तक नेपाल परिवर्तन क संकेत क बहुत बेसी कीमत चुका रहल अछि जे आम नागरिक एखन धरि नहि देख सकल अछि। बहुतो के लेल अंतिम भूसा छल निजी स्वास्थ्य सेवा आ शिक्षा पर 3% इक्विटी टैक्स। प्रधानमंत्री देबाल पर लिखल लेख पढ़ि कए पाछू घुमा देने बुझाइत छथि (पृष्ठ 1)।

अवैध पार्किंग के लेल बेर-बेर यातायात जुर्माना के बाद गणेश नेपाली के आत्मदाह सं पहिने यातायात उल्लंघन के लेल काफी कठोर दंड लागू करय वाला वाहन आ परिवहन प्रबंधन विधेयक सेहो सरकार प्रस्तावित केने छल. जांच क॑ भटकाबै लेली बलेंद्र शाह सरकार केरऽ समर्थक न॑ गैरकानूनी तरीका स॑ अपनऽ गाड़ी क॑ चुनिंदा मीडिया हाउस के सामने खड़ा करी देलकै, जेकरऽ बाद म॑ ओकरऽ खुद के पार्टी न॑ एकरऽ निंदा करलकै ।

हाल के ई मामला बताबैत अछि जे सरकार के एक हाथ के पता नहिं छनि जे दोसर हाथ की क’ रहल अछि. आरएसपी सरकार के करीब चारि महीना बाद पार्टी के दुर्जेय कवच मे दरार देखय लेल मिलय लागल अछि.

वैचारिक आ नीतिगत मतभेद के ल क प्रधानमंत्री के वित्त मंत्री स्वर्णिम वागले के बर्खास्त करय के तैयारी के ताजा अफवाह के संग एहि सप्ताह सब किछु चरम पर आबि गेल. वैगले’क इक्विटी टैक्स ओहि देश मे खराब सलाह देल गेल छल जतय प्राइवेट स्कूल या अस्पताल’क तलाश करय वाला जरूरी नहिं जे ओ धनिक होथि.

डस्टिन थानी मे रबी-स्वर्णिम गपशप फिलहाल एहि मुद्दा कए सुलझि गेल बुझाइत अछि। आब देखबाक अछि जे पार्टीक अध्यक्ष रबी लामिछाने कतेक दिन धरि नुकसान नियंत्रण करैत रहि सकैत छथि आ अगिला पांच साल धरि आरएसपी केँ एक संग राखि सकैत छथि। पार्टी आ पीएमओ मे व्यक्तित्व आ कार्यशैली मे असमंजस प्रतीत होइत अछि ।

अंतरराष्ट्रीय संबंधऽ के बारे म॑ प्रतिक्रिया प्रधानमंत्री तलक पहुँची रहलऽ नजर आबी रहलऽ छै जे आखिरकार ई सप्ताह के अंत म॑ भारतीय आरू चीनी दूतऽ स॑ अलग-अलग मुलाकात करी रहलऽ छै । ओ व्यवसायिक क्षेत्र स सेहो परामर्श दैत आबि रहल छथि।

उम्मीद अछि जे पीएमओ आओर आरएसपी जेना चुनाव प्रचार के दौरान एक संग आबि अपन भलाई के लेल बेसि जवाबदेही देखाओत. असफलता सेहो देश लेल कोनो विकल्प नहि अछि।
